title: New Developments In External Sector
definition: Recent structural transformations, policy interventions, trade pacts, and regulatory updates governing India's balance of payments, merchandise and services trade, capital flows, and international economic integration.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Exam (Prelims & Mains GS-3 Economy) as it directly impacts macroeconomic stability, export-led growth strategies, foreign exchange reserves management, and geopolitical positioning in global value chains.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of New Developments In External Sector.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) and Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI) norms
Functioning of WTO and Free Trade Agreements (FTAs)
